results.title: Publicly exposed asset is configured without authentication.
results.description: Publicly exposed asset is configured without authentication.
results.evidence: Supplied configuration identifies public exposure and no authentication.
results.remediation: Require appropriate authentication or document an approved, constrained public-access design.

results.title: Asset exposure is not established.
results.evidence: Input configuration sets exposure to unknown.
results.remediation: Confirm network reachability and document trust boundaries.

results.title: Dependency version is missing or not pinned.
results.description: Dependency version is missing or not pinned.
results.remediation: Resolve and pin an approved version; verify the lockfile and transitive dependency tree.

results.title: Observed API access behavior differs from the expected policy.
results.description: Observed API access behavior differs from the expected policy.
results.remediation: Verify the endpoint's authentication and authorization policy, correct enforcement, and add a regression test.

results.title: Recorded API outcome matches the declared expectation.
results.description: Recorded API outcome matches the declared expectation.
results.remediation: Retain the test as a regression check and validate coverage across protected endpoints.

results.title: API security behavior could not be verified.
results.description: API security behavior could not be verified.
results.remediation: Investigate the test error or execute the missing test and record the actual response.
